title: Embedded OLE object docx 001
notes: real package-level embedding plumbing, stub payload: word/embeddings/object1.bin added (the bin part is a 1x1 PNG byte stub declared with the oleObject relationship type and oleObject content type — the type/content mismatch is intentional: an honest stub, no CFB structure inside); body carries a legacy w:pict with v:shape o:ole=rId9 plus an o:OLEObject child (Type=Embed, DrawAspect=Icon) — no w:drawing used, so the w:drawing metric stays 0; document.xml.rels oleObject relationship + Content_Types oleObject override added via zip_read/zip_write. LibreOffice may show an icon or render nothing for the stub; the embed carries no text truth, so reference_text covers only the body text.
